exposure: Random assignment to knee-chest or supine position
Knee-chest position vs supine position after spinal anesthesia
outcome: Time to attain T6 block height
Time to achieve maximum sensory block height
Newborn Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: 45 ASA II pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Placing patients in the knee-chest position for one minute after spinal anesthesia administration significantly shortened the onset time of adequate surgical anesthesia for cesarean section compared to the supine position.
